touches.text: Trouble Ticket: an error that needs a non-automated fixer (CC or Akien).
The test before raising one: can only CC or Akien fix this? If not, it is a log line, not a trouble. One problem, one trouble.
Runs a proof as its own process and writes a validation record (claim, caller, date, method, verdict, evidence, falsifier, horizon).

Reds don't get lost. Each run writes a ticket for every new red it finds and every orphaned file it sees, unless one is already open for it. A red seen in passing gets the same treatment. Every red and every orphaned file is fixed; one unrelated to the work in hand is ticketed, and once it is, that crossing can go ahead.
Trouble: it has to be able to report when nothing else can, so a direct line makes sense for recovery (6.3.4).
Trouble tickets (3.4.3) live here. Any device has a direct line to raise one, not over the bus (2.3.7.1.3).

conflicts.text: Reds don't get lost. Each run writes a ticket for every new red it finds and every orphaned file it sees, unless one is already open for it. A red seen in passing gets the same treatment. Every red and every orphaned file is fixed; one unrelated to the work in hand is ticketed, and once it is, that crossing can go ahead.
conflicts.ticket_says: When the cast door refuses a red's ticket (raises RedTicketRefused), run_proof catches it, raises an unticketed trouble with details naming the door and lacks, emits red_unticketed, then re-raises (run exits non-zero). The trouble records that the outline was not met; the red still needs its ticket.
conflicts.why: The outline states: 'Each run writes a ticket for every new red it finds and every orphaned file it sees.' With the ticket built, runs do not write tickets when the casting door refuses—they record troubles instead. The clause 'Each run writes a ticket for every new red' no longer holds for all reds in all cases. The ticket acknowledges this in its constraint ('the trouble is the record that the outline was not met') but does not prevent the conflict. The outline's requirement that every new red receives a ticket is not met when casting fails.
